en.html:
I return to the world.

The self reduced to nothing has been restored to existence.
Thus the black vortex—a phenomenon of nothingness—has its existence logically denied. Collapse follows.

The blackness tears apart and scatters.
It looks like the death of a star.

en.html:
No longer the figure once called a silver meteor.

Wings torn.
Armour cracked.
The right arm is gone altogether.

A clear demonstration of what it means to have an ultimate technique defeated after committing all strength to it.

The force meant for the enemy falls upon the user.

It is natural that the tsurugi has almost ceased to function.
What is difficult to believe is the wielder's desperate strength: preventing complete shutdown and forcing herself to stand as well.

　全能総力を傾注した極技が破られる――その意味を、
克明に物語る姿だった。
